eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Nevada, CA; at 12:51 PM on AUG 27, 2022 Effective until 3:51 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Nevada County Sheriff's Office issuing an Evacuation ORDER for a Wildfire affecting zones NCO-E161 and Zone NCO-E397. There is a fast moving wildfire in the area of Still road EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY! Check Community.Zonehaven.com for updates.  Temporary Evacuation Point established at Bear River High School.
